The fold is scratch/sga735-finish/FoldCheck.lean (generated by gen/gen.py from the copy set r6taint_out.txt of R6Taint.lean on the closure of sixContactMin_of_open48; compiled, standard axioms): it adds OpenResearchLeaves32 and sixContactMin_of_open49 by copying (X -> X_nl / XNL) the 127 declarations on the path from the top to the field or to an r6-typed constant, with r6 re-typed to SGA735Nil.RaynaudCriterionNFNil, semistableUnipotent to SGA735Nil.SemistableUnipotentNilCP, the field to sga7_IX_3_5_ForwardUnipAC; the two readers of r6's conclusion are replaced by SGA7IX35UnipReaders.lean (raynaudPlace_of_R6Nil, goodReduction_of_QM_rational3_of_alg_nil). It supersedes sga735-narrow's fold (not on main). 'proof' names the conversion and consumer theorems, not a term of the field's type.
